name: Garden cress

schedule.notes: Succession every 7 to 10 days — bolts within 30 days of sowing.
Cut at 2 to 3 in with scissors. Cut high enough above the soil and you may get a second cut.

harvest.cues: Plants 2 to 3 in, two true leaves showing. Use immediately — flavor concentrates with age (and not always for the better).
harvest.storageNotes: Wraps in damp paper, fridge 2 to 3 days. Best the day picked.

varieties.name: Curled Cress
varieties.notes: Frilly, ornamental. The egg-and-cress sandwich classic.

notes: Fastest crop in the garden — sometimes salad-ready in 15 days. Even kids can grow it indoors on a damp paper towel. Slightly peppery; mellow when very young.
